user_saw: A Telegram private-chat message sent with a requested message effect arrived without the effect and without any error.
summary: Carries the shared message tool's effectId through Telegram's text, rich, media and location send paths as message_effect_id for private chats, omitting it for groups.
reasoning: At the fix's parent the Telegram plugin has no effect/message_effect_id code at all; the shared tool's effectId is described as 'sendWithEffect id/name' with iMessage-style effect names in its tests, so Telegram never implemented or promised effects. Forwarding it is a new Telegram capability rather than repair of broken behavior, so no causing commit applies.
